reducing-air-pollutants-devices.alt: Diagram matching devices to pollutants. At a coal power plant, exhaust passes an electrostatic precipitator or baghouse that removes particles, then a scrubber with limestone spray that removes sulfur dioxide. On a car, a catalytic converter changes CO, NOx and hydrocarbons into CO2, nitrogen gas and water. At a gas pump, a vapor recovery nozzle captures gasoline vapor.
